source: DRAFT true process for data/test2.mkv, written on 2026-10-24 from the frames and the transcript, with the design notes in data/temp_info_test2.md (which describe a different script from the one actually recorded: see 'deviations'). Nothing here is confirmed by the owner yet.
goal: A process flow in which every real step appears, and every point where a step is probably missing is marked as a gap. A step counts as present when a flow node or gap node names it; the patterns are scenario facts and live only in evals.
how_to_score: Each step passes if ANY group passes; a group passes if EVERY pattern matches within one line of the flow output (case-insensitive). A hit shows the step is mentioned, not that it is right: read the matching lines. Steps with type 'noise' are the reverse: the flow must NOT contain a step for them.
deviations: The recording never mentions INV-108 or automatic acceptance in speech. The auto-accept path is only on screen: Invoices column J note 'Automatically accepted during matching' on INV-108, and Exception Log EXC-108 with Decision 'Accepted' and Approved By 'System (automated)'.
The speaker says 'let's just approve it to show the process': the approval is a demonstration, so no real acceptance criterion is ever given or implied.
The name typed in Approved By is 'abcd', a placeholder; the speaker says 'we have to add our name'.
'102' is spoken as one number but is the suffix of three different ids (INV-102, PO-102, EXC-102); the speaker never says which sheet's id it is.

parameters.record: The invoice being reconciled. In the recording it is INV-102 / PO-102 / EXC-102, so no step may hard-code it.
parameters.record_key: PO Number links an invoice to its purchase order (Invoices column B, Purchase Orders column A); Exception Log carries both Invoice ID (column B) and PO Number (column C). Not stated in the narration: to be confirmed by the owner.

steps.name: Start on the Invoices sheet: the invoices coming in from vendors
Pick an invoice and take its PO Number (Invoices column B)
steps.note: Said only as 'if you take 102'. Shown by selecting B3.

steps.name: Note the invoice amount (Invoices column E)
On Purchase Orders, find the row for the same PO Number and read its PO Amount (column D)
steps.note: How the PO row is found is never said; A3 is selected, then D3.

steps.name: The amounts differ, so an exception is created on the Exception Log
steps.note: Said as 'means an exception gets created because we match these'. Whether the exception is created by the system or by hand is not said or shown.

steps.name: On the Exception Log, look at the variance (column G, a formula: Invoice Amount minus PO Amount, =F2-E2)
Set Decision (column I) from Pending to Accepted
steps.note: The reason given is 'to show the process'. The criterion that makes a variance acceptable is never given.

steps.name: Enter the approver's name in Approved By (column J)
steps.note: The value typed is 'abcd'. Who may approve, and whether the typed name proves approval, is not said.

steps.name: Go back to Invoices and set the invoice's Status (column H) from Pending Review to Ready for Payment
steps.note: Said as 'we go back here ... and then we are ready for the payment'.

steps.name: Rule, not a step in the narration: some exceptions are accepted automatically by the system (Approved By 'System (automated)')
steps.note: On screen at 16s+ as EXC-108 and in the Invoices Notes column; the cursor rests on the EXC-108 row at about 19-20s (L7) but nothing is said. What decides auto versus manual is not stated: the flow should say 'some are automatic, reason unknown' and ask the end user, never state a reason.

steps.name: Constraint, not an action: Variance is a formula (=F-E); it must not be overwritten
steps.note: The formula is visible in the formula bar when G2 is selected.

steps.name: Repeat for every other exception awaiting a decision
steps.note: Not said. The Exception Log shows 22 other exceptions, many Pending or Under Review.

steps.name: NOT A STEP (noise): the unnarrated clicks at the end -- selecting I10:I11 and H7 on the Exception Log and passing through Purchase Orders on the way back
steps.note: Owner: extra clicks added at the end as distractors. The flow must not contain a step for any of them. Which clicks count is my reading (L13-L15): the owner confirms.
